To start a VM from the virtual disk in Proxmox, you can follow these steps:

1. Go to the Proxmox web interface and log in.
2. Click on the "Nodes" tab and select the node where your VM is located.
3. Click on the "VMs" tab and select the VM that you want to start.
4. Click on the "Actions" dropdown menu and select "Start".
5. In the "Start" dialog box, make sure that the "Boot order" is set to "Hard disk 1" (or whatever your virtual disk is named).
6. Click "OK" to start the VM.

You can also use the Proxmox command-line interface (CLI) to start a VM from the virtual disk. To do this, you can use the following command:

```
qm start <vmid>
```

Replace `<vmid>` with the ID of your VM.

Source:
https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Documentation

Note: The above steps and commands are based on the Proxmox documentation and may be subject to change. It's always a good idea to check the official documentation for the most up-to-date information.
